description: Call this for a greeting (hi, hello), a connectivity/liveness test, 'what can you do', or any message too general to match a specific tool below. Returns the full menu of real questions this server answers (tickets, attendee perks, partnerships with ELC Conference 2027), each mapped to the tool name that answers it, so the next call can go straight to the right tool.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

name: get-started
